notes.title: 💀 New Boss Added — The Brute Has Entered the Fight! 🔥
notes.notes:
Development is moving forward — and today, we’re excited to introduce our first major boss fight!

Say hello to The Brute — a massive, mutated monster that now roams the battlefield. Don’t expect an easy kill. This beast is built to crush unprepared squads.

🧟 Tougher than anything you’ve faced before
🩸 Can soak up serious damage
⚔️ Requires coordination, timing, and heavy firepower to bring down

He’s already live in the current build — and trust us, he’s not going down without a fight. If you thought the early waves were easy... think again.

🎯 Think you're ready? Prove it in-game and let us know how your first encounter went.

🛠️ More features and enemies are coming soon as development continues. Stay with us — this is just the beginning.
